title: lepturus subulatus
intro: Lepturus subulatus, commonly known as Needle Grass, is a type of grass found in tropical and subtropical regions. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lepturus subulatus include reducing pain and fever, as well as its potential in treating skin conditions and wounds, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. However, the comprehensive understanding of its bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions requires further research and studies.
